test_name: Verify Admin User Search and Permission Management
description: This test verifies that an admin can search for a user, view their details, and manage their permissions (e.g., removing admin rights).
steps: Navigate to the Admin Dashboard page.
Locate the user search input field.
Type the username 'bhhavya.sureka' into the search input field.
Click the 'Apply' button to filter the results.
Verify that the user 'bhhavya.sureka' appears in the search results.
Click on the username 'bhhavya.sureka' to open the user details.
Locate the 'Remove Admin' button under permissions.
Confirm the removal action in the modal dialog (if applicable).
Verify that the user's admin rights have been successfully removed by checking their updated role in the user list.
expected_results: The user list is filtered to show 'bhhavya.sureka'.
Admin rights for 'bhhavya.sureka' are successfully removed.
edge_cases: User does not exist in the database.
Search input accepts special characters or invalid input.
Admin is unable to remove rights due to insufficient permissions.
Network latency causes delays in filtering results.
Modal confirmation dialog does not appear.
data_requirements: Admin role assigned to the test user.
Existing user records in the database.
Permissions data for validating admin rights.
Mocked backend data for testing network failures.
dependencies: Admin user must be logged into the dashboard.
User 'bhhavya.sureka' must exist in the system.
Admin user must have permission to manage roles.
api_interactions: GET request to fetch user list.
POST request to update user permissions.
PUT request to confirm admin removal.
performance_metrics: Time taken to filter search results.
Response time for permission update API.
Page load speed for user details.
accessibility_requirements: Ensure screen reader compatibility for the search input field.
Verify keyboard navigation for search and action buttons.
Check color contrast ratios for error messages and modal dialogs.
